title: Microsatellite Polymorphisms Adjacent to the Oxytocin Receptor Gene in Domestic Cats: Association with Personality?
sample_size_analysed: 混种猫 100 只（家庭 85 + 猫咖 15）+ 纯种猫 40 只

one_line_conclusion_zh: 雄激素受体基因微卫星（MS3）与猫的友好性评分存在关联，但作者自己称为"marginally significant"。
